headline: EGMemory reports evidence-chain memory gains on multi-actor conversation benchmarks
summary: An October 13 arXiv revision presents EGMemory, a training-free memory framework that preserves message provenance and state histories in evidence chains, verifies proposed updates against source messages and prior state, and navigates evidence iteratively at answer time. The authors report 68.2% accuracy on GroupMemBench and 77.9% on EverMemBench, 22.7 and 21.4 percentage points above the strongest evaluated baselines; on dyadic LoCoMo they report 73.6%, 4.3 points above the best listed baseline. The results are paper-reported and have not been independently reproduced.
